This cabin is cozy, rustic and quaint. It used to be the old Ice House on the property in the early 1900’s. This camping cabin is equipped with one double bed, toilet and sink. There is no shower in the cabin and offers cold water only. There is electric heat for those cool fall nights! This cabin is great for two couples or two adults and two children.
